replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I struggle with math, often finding it confusing. My education stopped at upper secondary, and I never really connected with mathematical concepts. I prefer subjects like physics, which feel more concrete to me.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, math makes me anxious. It reminds me of my struggles in school and the fear of not understanding. Even simple problems can feel overwhelming, so I avoid them when possible.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried an AI math tutor last year, but it didn’t help much. The explanations were too technical for my level. I prefer learning from people who can simplify things for me.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation like ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If it’s positive, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a). If not, there are no real solutions. I might get this wrong, though.

Find where the derivative f’(x) = 0. First, take the derivative of f(x). Then, set it equal to zero and solve for x. The solutions are critical points. Check if they’re maxima, minima, or inflection points by looking at the second derivative. Math is hard, so this is my best shot.
